## Summary

I've successfully added real CSV export functionality to the admin leaderboard components. Here's what I implemented:

### 1. Created Server Actions for Data Export

Created `src/app/actions/leaderboard-export.ts` with three server actions:
- `getLeaderboardDataForExport()` - Fetches all user leaderboard data
- `getRestaurantLeaderboardDataForExport()` - Fetches all restaurant leaderboard data  
- `getRaffleEntriesDataForExport()` - Fetches all raffle entries data

Each function:
- Fetches data with no limits (up to 1000 records)
- Converts BigInt values to strings for serialization
- Transforms data into CSV-friendly format
- Includes proper error handling
- Adds export timestamp

### 2. Updated AdminLeaderboardActions Component

Enhanced `src/components/admin/leaderboard/admin-leaderboard-actions.tsx`:
- Added real export functionality for both leaderboard data and raffle entries
- **Export Data button** now exports both user and restaurant leaderboards as separate CSV files
- **Export Entries button** now exports raffle entries data
- Added proper loading states and error handling
- Used the existing `exportToCSV` utility from `@/lib/csv`
- Added TypeScript type guards to prevent undefined data issues

### 3. Enhanced AdminRaffleEntries Component

Updated `src/components/admin/leaderboard/admin-raffle-entries.tsx`:
- Added export functionality that works with selected entries or all entries
- Added export button that dynamically shows "Export Selected" or "Export All"
- Includes loading states and proper error handling
- Transforms raffle entry data for CSV export with all relevant fields

### Key Features

1. **Smart Export Logic**: 
   - Leaderboard exports create two separate files (users and restaurants)
   - Raffle entries can export selected entries or all entries
   - Timestamped filenames for easy organization

2. **Comprehensive Data Fields**:
   - User leaderboard: rank, userName, punchCardCount, userId, exportedAt
   - Restaurant leaderboard: rank, restaurantName, punchCardCount, restaurantId, imageUrl, exportedAt
   - Raffle entries: rank, userName, restaurantName, enteredAt, status, raffleEntryId, userId, restaurantId, punchCardId, exportedAt

3. **User Experience**:
   - Loading states with spinners
   - Success/error toast notifications
   - Proper TypeScript typing
   - Follows existing codebase patterns

4. **Error Handling**:
   - Server-side error handling in actions
   - Client-side error handling with user feedback
   - Graceful fallbacks for missing data

The implementation follows the existing codebase patterns and uses the established CSV export utility, making it consistent with other export functionality in the application.

+             <CardTitle className='flex items-center gap-2'>
+               <Shuffle className='h-5 w-5' />
+               Raffle Drawing
+             </CardTitle>
+             <CardDescription>
+               Conduct a random drawing from all active entries
+             </CardDescription>
+           </CardHeader>
+           <CardContent className='space-y-4'>
+             {isDrawing && (
+               <div className='space-y-2'>
+                 <div className='flex items-center gap-2'>
+                   <RefreshCw className='h-4 w-4 animate-spin' />
+                   <span className='text-sm'>Drawing in progress...</span>
+                 </div>
+                 <Progress value={drawingProgress} className='w-full' />
+               </div>
+             )}
+ 
+             <AnimatePresence>
+               {winner && (
+                 <motion.div
+                   initial={{opacity: 0, scale: 0.8}}
+                   animate={{opacity: 1, scale: 1}}
+                   exit={{opacity: 0, scale: 0.8}}
+                   className='p-4 bg-gradient-to-r from-yellow-50 to-orange-50 border border-yellow-200 rounded-lg'
+                 >
+                   <div className='flex items-center gap-3'>
+                     <div className='relative'>
+                       <Avatar className='h-12 w-12'>
+                         <AvatarFallback className='bg-yellow-500 text-white'>
+                           {winner.userName.charAt(0)}
+                         </AvatarFallback>
+                       </Avatar>
+                       <Crown className='h-6 w-6 text-yellow-500 absolute -top-2 -right-2' />
+                     </div>
+                     <div className='flex-1'>
+                       <div className='flex items-center gap-2'>
+                         <h3 className='font-semibold'>{winner.userName}</h3>
+                         <Badge className='bg-yellow-500 hover:bg-yellow-600'>
+                           <Sparkles className='h-3 w-3 mr-1' />
+                           Winner
+                         </Badge>
+                       </div>
+                       <p className='text-sm text-muted-foreground'>
+                         Entry from {winner.restaurantName}
+                       </p>
+                       <p className='text-xs text-muted-foreground'>
+                         Entered{' '}
+                         {new Date(winner.enteredAt).toLocaleDateString()}
+                       </p>
+                     </div>
+                   </div>
+                 </motion.div>
+               )}
+             </AnimatePresence>
+ 
+             <div className='flex gap-2'>
+               <Button
+                 onClick={handleDrawWinner}
+                 disabled={isDrawing || entries.length === 0}
+                 className='flex-1'
+               >
+                 {isDrawing ? (
+                   <>
+                     <RefreshCw className='h-4 w-4 mr-2 animate-spin' />
+                     Drawing...
+                   </>
+                 ) : (
+                   <>
+                     <Shuffle className='h-4 w-4 mr-2' />
+                     Draw Winner
+                   </>
+                 )}
+               </Button>
+               {winner && (
+                 <Button variant='outline' onClick={handleResetRaffle}>
+                   Reset
+                 </Button>
+               )}
+             </div>
+           </CardContent>
+         </Card>
+ 
+         {/* Recent Entries Preview */}
+         <Card>
+           <CardHeader>
+             <CardTitle className='flex items-center gap-2'>
+               <Users className='h-5 w-5' />
+               Recent Entries
+             </CardTitle>
+             <CardDescription>Latest 5 raffle entries</CardDescription>
+           </CardHeader>
+           <CardContent>
+             <div className='space-y-3'>
+               {entries.slice(0, 5).map((entry, index) => (
+                 <div
+                   key={entry.raffleEntryId.toString()}
+                   className='flex items-center gap-3 p-2 rounded-lg hover:bg-muted/50'
+                 >
+                   <div className='text-sm font-medium text-muted-foreground'>
+                     #{index + 1}
+                   </div>
+                   <Avatar className='h-8 w-8'>
+                     <AvatarFallback className='bg-primary text-primary-foreground'>
+                       {entry.userName.charAt(0)}
+                     </AvatarFallback>
+                   </Avatar>
+                   <div className='flex-1'>
+                     <div className='font-medium'>{entry.userName}</div>
+                     <div className='text-sm text-muted-foreground'>
+                       {entry.restaurantName}
+                     </div>
+                   </div>
+                   <div className='text-xs text-muted-foreground'>
+                     {new Date(entry.enteredAt).toLocaleDateString()}
+                   </div>
+                 </div>
+               ))}
+               {entries.length === 0 && (
+                 <div className='text-center py-8 text-muted-foreground'>
+                   <AlertCircle className='h-8 w-8 mx-auto mb-2' />
+                   <p>No raffle entries found</p>
+                 </div>
+               )}
+             </div>
+           </CardContent>
+         </Card>
+ 
+         <DialogFooter className='flex justify-between'>
+           <Button
+             variant='outline'
+             onClick={handleExportRaffleData}
+             disabled={isExporting}
+           >
+             {isExporting ? (
+               <>
+                 <RefreshCw className='h-4 w-4 mr-2 animate-spin' />
+                 Exporting...
+               </>
+             ) : (
+               <>
+                 <Download className='h-4 w-4 mr-2' />
+                 Export Data
+               </>
+             )}
+           </Button>
+           <Button variant='outline' onClick={() => setIsOpen(false)}>
+             Close
+           </Button>
+         </DialogFooter>
+       </DialogContent>
+     </Dialog>
+   )
+ }
+
